hardening.minimized_reason: Mastodon for werewolf's mastodon form, as Wolfi would package it: built by melange in Wolfi's environment with Wolfi's Ruby 4.0 and Node 24, its gems' native parts linked to Wolfi's libpq, ICU, libidn, libyaml and OpenSSL, so their fixes reach a machine with the rest of its packages (howl unpacks it into the image and checks what it links: cmd/howl/melange.zig). The assets are built here, so the machine runs Node only for the streaming server. Offered to wolfi-dev/os as it is; when Wolfi ships it, the form names the package and this file goes.
hardening.pledge_reason: No package-enforced pledge-style capability policy is claimed; service confinement is tracked in Werewolf forms.
